paragraphs: The all-new EAVISION C500 has a maximum single-aircraft payload of 240 kg. Its quad-rotor, eight-propeller design delivers a total thrust of 720 kg for outstanding stability and reliability. Dual-battery and quad-battery modes switch flexibly, and ultra-fast charging fills it in just 7 minutes.
Nine-camera vision and multi-source radar are deeply fused to build an all-domain perception perimeter. An end-to-end neural-network paradigm redefines the aerial logistics system.
Automatic sway elimination and full safety-boundary coverage. Supports 30 km 4G+ video transmission. Multi-aircraft collaboration pushes beyond the limits of payload.
overview.technologyAlt: Bringing embodied intelligence to heavy lift: from the decision brain, perception midbrain, flight-control cerebellum, integrated airframe and operations system — a five-layer technology foundation for a true heavy-lift flying robot

notes.aria: Product usage notes and data conditions
intro: * Please check, confirm, and strictly comply with local laws and regulations before flying.

** All videos and images on this page were captured in strict compliance with applicable local laws and regulations. Please familiarize yourself with local laws and regulations and ensure the aircraft has the required certifications before flying.
*** Product appearance is subject to the actual shipped unit.

**** Payload figures are measured at sea level. The app intelligently evaluates loading safety based on current aircraft status, battery status, and environmental conditions. Please load according to the weight status shown in the app; otherwise flight safety may be affected.

items.text: 1. Measured with the C500 in a quad-battery, unloaded configuration fitted with the lifting system, flying forward at 20 m/s at equivalent sea-level altitude, 25°C ambient temperature, and in windless conditions until the battery was depleted and a forced landing occurred. Data is for reference only; results may vary under different external environments, usage methods, and firmware versions. Please pay attention to app prompts during actual flights.

2. The 30 km transmission distance is achieved only under the FCC standard. In mainland China, where the SRRC standard applies, the maximum video transmission distance is 20 km. The above data was measured outdoors in open, interference-free conditions and represents the maximum one-way, no-return communication distance under each standard. Please pay attention to return-to-home prompts in the app during actual flights.
3. Derived from comparisons with conventional cargo drones; conclusions may vary under different test conditions.
4. Maximum flight speed depends on the number of batteries and payload weight. Please fly safely in strict accordance with app prompts and warnings.
5. Payload capacity decreases as takeoff altitude increases. 6,000 m is the maximum safe flight altitude for the aircraft (with takeoff at 4,500 m).
7. This feature will be supported through a future firmware upgrade. Please watch for the relevant firmware update notes on the remote controller and the official website.

8. The effective perception range and the obstacle avoidance and bypass capabilities vary with ambient light, rain and fog, and the material, position, and shape of target objects. Downward perception assists terrain-following altitude hold, while perception in other directions is used for obstacle avoidance. Except in scenarios with linear obstacles, if obstacle avoidance fails at speeds of 13.8 m/s or below and damages the aircraft, liability can be determined through log analysis, and repairs are free of charge if the cause is not human error. In scenarios with linear obstacles, the corresponding speed is 10 m/s or below. For operational safety, power lines, guy wires, and similar hazards are recommended to be marked as obstacles.
extra: (1) Downward perception assists terrain-following altitude hold. Users should watch the flight environment; damage caused by colliding with obstacles below is not covered by the free warranty;
(2) The aircraft cannot actively avoid moving objects. Users should watch the flight environment; damage caused in such scenarios is not covered by the free warranty;

(3) Cargo obstacle avoidance is an assistive function only. Users should watch the flight environment; damage caused by the cargo or lifting rope colliding with obstacles is not covered by the free warranty;

items.text: 9. The second remote controller is optional and requires an additional purchase.

10. Measured at equivalent sea-level altitude, 15–40°C ambient temperature, with single-battery sequential charging, from 30% to 95% charge. Fast charging is supported when the battery cell temperature is between 15°C and 70°C. Charging time varies with input power, altitude, starting charge level, and other factors.
